data.markdown: **Escalate P2: Active Cobalt Strike C2 beaconing confirmed on WS-FIN-0142**Host WS-FIN-0142 (user l.hassan) initiated 412 HTTPS connections to malicious IP 203.0.113.66 at fixed 60-second intervals over seven hours.
